brief: Write `first_pair_sum(nums, target)` that returns the first pair of indices (i, j), with i < j, where nums[i] + nums[j] == target. Return None if no pair exists.

attacks.message: The Nest Hydra's inner head strikes — your inner loop starts in the wrong place.
Both heads bite — an index ran past the end of the list.
The Hydra tramples you. Somewhere, a loop never breaks.

tests.label: Finds a pair in [2, 7, 11, 15] for target 9
Never pairs an index with itself
Stops searching once a pair is found

hintCards.title: Nested loop indices
hintCards.body: The inner loop should start at i + 1, not 0 — otherwise you compare an element with itself or re-check pairs you already tried.

hintCards.title: Breaking out early
hintCards.body: Once you find a match, return immediately — no need to keep looping.
